changes: Title pages no longer carry the trailer embed that made them stick: the poster stands, and trailers still open from their button
Categories, the category pages and Watch in Your Language now read everything your chats hold, not just the chip you are on, and the Categories list is plain slim lines in Netflix shape
A big channel's older videos now reach the categories too: Home reads deeper into the chats you picked
Watch in Your Language holds every language your videos name, and every tile opens its language page
The Home banner waits longer for its artwork on slow connections, so the Movies banner stands again

The quality chooser now carries the levels: UHD, QHD for 1440p, FHD for a 1080p copy of 2 GB or more, HD+ under it, HD for a 720p copy of 1.5 GB or more, and SD under that; the Copies lists group by resolution as before
PreHD copies now hide with the cam family, and split part files (.001, .002 and the like) fold into the one video or stay out of the copies
Subtitle search finds series episodes better: SubDL is asked plainer and plainer until it answers, and by the title's own ids too
Subtitle downloads now show their percent and survive a Back press inside the picker: go back and the download still finishes
Back from a title opened in a category returns to that category page
